# Duluth Dental Studio

> Comprehensive family oral healthcare practice serving patients of all ages in Duluth, Georgia.

## Core Information
- Location: 3575 Koger Blvd, Suite 160, Duluth, GA 30096
- Phone: (770) 696-4144
- Hours: Monday-Thursday 8am-5pm, Friday 8am-2pm
- Services: General Dentistry, Pediatric Dentistry, Cosmetic Dentistry, Restorative Dentistry, Dental Implants, Clear Aligners, Emergency Care
- Website: https://duluthdentalstudio.netlify.app/

- [Home Page](https://duluthdentalstudio.netlify.app/index.html): Overview of services, mission, vision, and patient benefits.
- [About Us](https://duluthdentalstudio.netlify.app/about.html): Practice history, technology integration, and patient care philosophy.
- [Contact Us](https://duluthdentalstudio.netlify.app/contact.html): Office location, hours, appointment scheduling, and emergency inquiry forms.
